title: German FM Urges Russia to Abandon 'Dangerous Escalation'
detail: German Foreign Minister met with Russian counterpart and urged Russia to abandon what Berlin described as dangerous escalation in the Ukraine conflict, marking a rare high-level diplomatic contact between Germany and Russia.

title: Finland's Stubb Credits Trump for Pushing Ukraine Peace Talks
detail: Finland's President Alexander Stubb credited US President Trump for pushing Ukraine peace talks forward, while dismissing fears of a direct Russian invasion of NATO territory. Stubb's remarks reflect cautious Nordic-Atlantic optimism about potential negotiation pathways, even as the conflict continues on the ground.

title: Russia Escalates Hybrid Warfare Operations Across Europe
detail: Russia is intensifying hybrid warfare operations beyond Ukraine, including sabotage, cyberattacks, and disinformation campaigns across Europe, alarming NATO allies. Western intelligence agencies have documented an uptick in Russian-linked incidents targeting critical infrastructure, democratic institutions, and NATO member states' internal security.

title: Zelenskyy Claims Russia Lost Over 10,000 Troops in Single Week
detail: Zelenskyy announced Russia lost more than 10,000 troops in a single week of fighting, marking one of the highest weekly casualty claims since the war began, per UNITED24 Media. The figure underscores the intensity of ongoing combat operations on the eastern and southern fronts.
